description: This file contains classes and functions related to layout test management, including test expectations, test list management, mock filesystem setup, and a test port and driver implementation for running layout tests in a simulated environment.

classes.name: TestInstance
classes.description: Represents a single layout test with its expected and actual results, including various failure modes and test attributes.

classes.name: TestList
classes.description: Manages a collection of TestInstance objects, allowing addition of tests and reftests, and retrieval of test keys.

classes.name: TestPort
classes.description: A mock implementation of a layout test port, supporting test configuration, filesystem paths, and test management.

classes.name: TestDriver
classes.description: A dummy driver implementation used for testing layout test execution, simulating test runs and crashes.

methods.name: unit_test_list
methods.description: Creates and returns a TestList populated with a predefined set of tests and expected results.

methods.name: add_unit_tests_to_mock_filesystem
methods.description: Sets up a mock filesystem with test files, expectations, and directories for layout tests.
